### God Remembers Hannah
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/god-remembers-hannah
Passage: 1 Samuel 1:19-28
Points:
- Miraculous births throughout Scripture repeatedly signal significant new developments in God's plan of redemption.
- God remembering Hannah signifies His covenant intervention to rescue the afflicted from distress and shame.
- Granting Samuel to Israel preserved God's covenant people by preparing the nation for kingship and the ultimate coming of Christ.
- Believers can take comfort knowing God never forgets His people or His promises of salvation.

### Day 6: 1 Samuel 1:19–28
Author: Beth Moore
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/plus/books/portraits-of-devotion/portraits-of-devotion-day-6-1-samuel-1-1928.html
Passage: 1 Samuel 1:19-28
Points:
- Hannah faithfully fulfilled her difficult vow to surrender her young, deeply loved son to the house of the Lord.
- God sovereignly used Hannah's barrenness and desperate prayers to raise up a dedicated prophet whose impact surpassed ordinary parental plans.
- During Samuel's earliest years, Hannah actively instilled a heart of faith and worship in him.
- Believers are called to emulate Hannah's faith by surrendering their children and treasures back to God.
